title: Data Flows and Colonial Regimes in Africa: A Critical Analysis of the Colonial Futurities Embedded in AI Recommendation Algorithms
findings: This paper does not contain any analysis or findings related to religion or faith. Its focus is on algorithmic colonialism, data governance, and power dynamics in the context of AI in Africa.
